text: Who plays Ty Bell in Ghost Soldier? Alexej Manvelov in the 2026 film. Alexej Manvelov plays Ty Bell in Ghost Soldier, the 2026 American action film directed by William Eubank. The film is listed for a US release on November 11, 2026, from Sony Pictures Releasing through Columbia Pictures.. Ghost Soldier is set for its US release on November 11, 2026, so the full cast list, including Ty Bell's actor, is now being published. The film has been listed with its cast and release details ahead of its opening.. Manvelov is credited as Ty Bell in the cast list of the film, which stars Jim Caviezel as Henry "Fitz" Fitzgerald. The film's listing on The Movie Database also names Ricky Whittle as McNeil and Olivia Chenery as Sarah Taran among the cast. Manvelov's earlier credits include Garo in the miniseries Chernobyl (2019), Alexei Petrov in Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan (2018), Akram Salim in Dept. Q (2025), and Nikolai in Occupied (2015). He also appears uncredited as an Asset in The Contractor (2022). Ghost Soldier was first released in France on November 4, 2026, before its US premiere on November 11, 2026, which was set to coincide with Veterans Day. The film is rated PG-13 by the Motion Picture Association for strong violence, some bloody images, and language. Filming took place in Romania beginning August 18, 2025.

What is winter blend gasoline? Cheaper fuel sold outside summer months. Winter blend gasoline is a gasoline formula that filling stations may sell outside the summer season, which runs from June 1 to Sept. 15 under federal rules. It is cheaper to produce than summer blend, so pump prices often fall in the autumn.. Oil prices fell to their lowest since late August after Trump said the Iran war was "effectively over," and US pump prices dropped below $4 a gallon as stations switched to winter blend fuel.. The summer blend is designed to guard against evaporation, which matters in hot weather. Federal rules require stations to sell it from June 1 to Sept. 15. Outside that period, stations may switch to the winter blend, which costs less to make. The switch is one reason pump prices slipped this month. The national average for regular gasoline fell to $3.9788 a gallon on Tuesday, Nov. 10, according to AAA, the first time below $4 since July 20. It had been $4.56 earlier this year. AAA says prices typically fall 10 to 30 cents a gallon during the winter months, partly because demand drops as people take fewer road trips. Crude oil also contributed. Brent crude fell to $89.66 a barrel on Tuesday morning in London, its lowest since Aug. 31, after President Donald Trump said the war with Iran was "effectively over." Brent had peaked at $113.43 on Oct. 30. Gas prices remain more than 30% above their level before the war began on Feb. 28.
